title: GeoQuads — Daily
spoiler: Think rivers in Africa and Asia.
help: Find the 4 hidden categories. Each has 4 unique items.

groups.name: The Nile flows through it
groups.fact: At about 6,650 km, the Nile is traditionally counted as the longest river in the world.

groups.name: The Mekong flows through it
groups.fact: The Mekong runs through six countries: China, Myanmar, Laos, Thailand, Cambodia and Vietnam.

groups.name: The Niger river flows through it
groups.fact: The Niger starts only about 240 km from the Atlantic, yet flows away from the sea into the Sahara before curving back.

groups.name: The Amu Darya flows through it
groups.fact: In ancient times the Amu Darya was known as the Oxus.
